maintenance.title: 维护模式
maintenance.desc: 维护模式控制台：实时状态、人工开关、定时窗口与 IP 白名单。生效后非白名单访客将收到 503（登录、探针与维护接口仍放行）。
maintenance.whitelisted: 当前 IP 在白名单
maintenance.switchHint: 开启后，除白名单 IP 与登录 / 探针 / 维护接口外，所有请求都会返回 503。
maintenance.messageHint: 展示给访客的 503 页面文案（最多 500 字）。
maintenance.messagePlaceholder: 如：升级中，10 分钟后回来
maintenance.scheduleHint: 到点自动生效 / 失效，无需再手动开关。
maintenance.timezoneHint: 时区：{tz}。不带时区偏移的时间在后端按 UTC 解释。
maintenance.clearScheduleConfirm: 确定清除当前定时维护窗口吗？
maintenance.scheduleRequired: 请填写开始与结束时间
maintenance.scheduleInvalid: 结束时间必须晚于开始时间
maintenance.whitelistHint: 白名单内的 IP 在维护期间仍可正常访问。
maintenance.removeWhitelistConfirm: 确定从白名单移除 {ip} 吗？
maintenance.whitelistEmpty: 白名单为空，任何访客都将看到维护页。
maintenance.previewHint: 预览复用公开的 status 接口，从你的浏览器发起。若你的 IP 在白名单中，这里会显示「正常运行」，但访客仍会看到维护页。
maintenance.enableConfirm: 开启后将立刻对访客返回 503（白名单 IP 除外）。确定开启吗？

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.desc: Maintenance mode console: live status, manual switch, scheduled window and IP whitelist. When active, non-whitelisted visitors get 503 (login, probes and the maintenance API stay open).
maintenance.switchHint: When on, every request except whitelisted IPs and the login / probe / maintenance APIs returns 503.
maintenance.messageHint: Text shown on the visitor 503 page (max 500 characters).
maintenance.scheduleHint: Takes effect and expires automatically at the given times — no manual switch needed.
maintenance.timezoneHint: Timezone: {tz}. Times without an offset are interpreted as UTC by the server.
maintenance.clearScheduleConfirm: Clear the current scheduled maintenance window?
maintenance.scheduleRequired: Please fill in both start and end time
maintenance.scheduleInvalid: End time must be later than start time
maintenance.whitelistHint: Whitelisted IPs keep full access during maintenance.
maintenance.whitelistEmpty: Whitelist is empty — every visitor will see the maintenance page.
maintenance.previewHint: Preview reuses the public status endpoint, called from your browser. If your IP is whitelisted it shows "Operational", even though visitors still see the maintenance page.
maintenance.previewActive: Visitors will see the maintenance page (503).
maintenance.previewInactive: Visitors can access the site normally.
maintenance.enableConfirm: Turning on returns 503 to visitors immediately (whitelisted IPs excepted). Turn it on?
